passages.text: Now a man named Micah from the hill country of Ephraim said to his mother, “The eleven hundred shekels of silver that were taken from you and about which I heard you utter a curse—I have the silver here with me; I took it.” Then his mother said, “Blessed be my son by the LORD!”
passages.sermon:
Micah was a man from the hill country of Ephraim.
Micah spoke to his mother.
He said, “The eleven hundred pieces of silver were taken from you.
You pronounced a curse about the silver.
I heard you say it.
I have the silver with me.
I took it.”
His mother replied, “Blessed be my son by the LORD.”
passages.original: וַֽיְהִי־ אִ֥ישׁ מֵֽהַר־ אֶפְרָ֖יִם וּשְׁמ֥וֹ מִיכָֽיְהוּ׃ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לְאִמּ֡וֹ אֶלֶף֩ וּמֵאָ֨ה הַכֶּ֜סֶף אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֻֽקַּֽח־ לָ֗ךְ וְאַתִּי אָלִית֙ וְגַם֙ אָמַ֣רְתְּ בְּאָזְנַ֔י הִנֵּֽה־ הַכֶּ֥סֶף אִתִּ֖י אֲנִ֣י לְקַחְתִּ֑יו וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אִמּ֔וֹ בָּר֥וּךְ בְּנִ֖י לַיהוָֽה׃

passages.text: And when he had returned the eleven hundred shekels of silver to his mother, she said, “I wholly dedicate the silver to the LORD for my son’s benefit, to make a graven image and a molten idol. Therefore I will now return it to you.”
passages.sermon:
Micah was a man from the hill country of Ephraim.
Micah returned the eleven hundred shekels of silver to his mother.
His mother spoke to him.
She said she wholly dedicated the silver to the LORD.
She said she gave the silver from her own hand for her son.
She said the purpose was to make a graven image and a molten idol.
She said she would now return the silver to him.
passages.original: וַיָּ֛שֶׁב אֶת־ אֶֽלֶף־ וּמֵאָ֥ה הַכֶּ֖סֶף לְאִמּ֑וֹ וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אִמּ֡וֹ הַקְדֵּ֣שׁ הִקְדַּ֣שְׁתִּי אֶת־ הַכֶּסֶף֩ לַיהוָ֨ה מִיָּדִ֜י לִבְנִ֗י לַֽעֲשׂוֹת֙ פֶּ֣סֶל וּמַסֵּכָ֔ה וְעַתָּ֖ה אֲשִׁיבֶ֥נּוּ לָֽךְ׃

passages.text: So he returned the silver to his mother, and she took two hundred shekels of silver and gave them to a silversmith, who made them into a graven image and a molten idol. And they were placed in the house of Micah.
passages.sermon:
Micah was a man from the hill country of Ephraim.
Micah returned the silver to his mother.
His mother took two hundred shekels of silver.
She gave the silver to a silversmith.
The silversmith made a carved image and a cast idol from the silver.
They placed the image and the idol in Micah’s house.
passages.original: וַיָּ֥שֶׁב אֶת־ הַכֶּ֖סֶף לְאִמּ֑וֹ וַתִּקַּ֣ח אִמּוֹ֩ מָאתַ֨יִם כֶּ֜סֶף וַתִּתְּנֵ֣הוּ לַצּוֹרֵ֗ף וַֽיַּעֲשֵׂ֙הוּ֙ פֶּ֣סֶל וּמַסֵּכָ֔ה וַיְהִ֖י בְּבֵ֥ית מִיכָֽיְהוּ׃

passages.text: Now this man Micah had a shrine, and he made an ephod and some household idols, and ordained one of his sons as his priest.
passages.sermon:
Micah was a man in Israel.
Micah had a shrine in his house.
Micah made an ephod.
Micah made household idols.
Micah appointed one of his sons to be a priest for him.
passages.original: וְהָאִ֣ישׁ מִיכָ֔ה ל֖וֹ בֵּ֣ית אֱלֹהִ֑ים וַיַּ֤עַשׂ אֵפוֹד֙ וּתְרָפִ֔ים וַיְמַלֵּ֗א אֶת־ יַ֤ד אַחַד֙ מִבָּנָ֔יו וַיְהִי־ ל֖וֹ לְכֹהֵֽן׃

passages.text: In those days there was no king in Israel; everyone did what was right in his own eyes.
passages.sermon:
Israel had no king in those days.
No one ruled over the people.
Each person did what seemed right to himself.
Everyone followed his own way.
passages.original: בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֔ם אֵ֥ין מֶ֖לֶךְ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אִ֛ישׁ הַיָּשָׁ֥ר בְּעֵינָ֖יו יַעֲשֶֽׂה׃פ

passages.text: And there was a young Levite from Bethlehem in Judah who had been residing within the clan of Judah.
passages.sermon:
A young man lived in Bethlehem.
Bethlehem was in the land of Judah.
This young man was a Levite.
He belonged to the tribe of Levi.
He lived among the people of Judah.
He stayed there as a resident.
passages.original: וַיְהִי־ נַ֗עַר מִבֵּ֥ית לֶ֙חֶם֙ יְהוּדָ֔ה מִמִּשְׁפַּ֖חַת יְהוּדָ֑ה וְה֥וּא לֵוִ֖י וְה֥וּא גָֽר־ שָֽׁם׃

passages.text: This man left the city of Bethlehem in Judah to settle where he could find a place. And as he traveled, he came to Micah’s house in the hill country of Ephraim.
passages.sermon:
There was a young Levite.
He lived in Bethlehem in Judah.
He belonged to the tribe of Levi.
He was staying among the people of Judah.
He left the city of Bethlehem in Judah.
He wanted to find a new place to live.
He traveled to look for a place to settle.
He came to the hill country of Ephraim.
He arrived at the house of Micah.
He stopped there on his journey.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֨לֶךְ הָאִ֜ישׁ מֵהָעִ֗יר מִבֵּ֥ית לֶ֙חֶם֙ יְהוּדָ֔ה לָג֖וּר בַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר יִמְצָ֑א וַיָּבֹ֧א הַר־ אֶפְרַ֛יִם עַד־ בֵּ֥ית מִיכָ֖ה לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת דַּרְכּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: “Where are you from?” Micah asked him. “I am a Levite from Bethlehem in Judah,” he replied, “and I am on my way to settle wherever I can find a place.”
passages.sermon:
Micah met a young man.
Micah spoke to him.
Micah asked, “Where are you from?”
The young man answered Micah.
He said, “I am a Levite.”
He said, “I am from Bethlehem in Judah.”
He said, “I am traveling.”
He said, “I am looking for a place to live.”
passages.original: וַיֹּאמֶר־ ל֥וֹ מִיכָ֖ה מֵאַ֣יִן תָּב֑וֹא וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֜יו לֵוִ֣י אָנֹ֗כִי מִבֵּ֥ית לֶ֙חֶם֙ יְהוּדָ֔ה וְאָנֹכִ֣י הֹלֵ֔ךְ לָג֖וּר בַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר אֶמְצָֽא׃

passages.text: “Stay with me,” Micah said to him, “and be my father and priest, and I will give you ten shekels of silver per year, a suit of clothes, and your provisions.” So the Levite went in and agreed to stay with him, and the young man became like a son to Micah.
passages.sermon:
Micah met a Levite who came from Bethlehem in Judah.
Micah spoke to the Levite.
Micah said, “Stay with me.”
Micah asked the Levite to be his father and his priest.
Micah promised to give the Levite ten shekels of silver each year.
Micah also promised to give the Levite a suit of clothes.
Micah promised to provide the Levite with food and what he needed.
The Levite agreed to stay with Micah.
The Levite went into Micah’s house.
The Levite lived with Micah.
The young Levite became like one of Micah’s sons.
passages.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ ל֨וֹ מִיכָ֜ה שְׁבָ֣ה עִמָּדִ֗י וֶֽהְיֵה־ לִי֮ לְאָ֣ב וּלְכֹהֵן֒ וְאָנֹכִ֨י אֶֽתֶּן־ לְךָ֜ עֲשֶׂ֤רֶת כֶּ֙סֶף֙ לַיָּמִ֔ים וְעֵ֥רֶךְ בְּגָדִ֖ים וּמִחְיָתֶ֑ךָ וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ הַלֵּוִֽי׃ וַיּ֥וֹאֶל הַלֵּוִ֖י לָשֶׁ֣בֶת אֶת־ הָאִ֑ישׁ וַיְהִ֤י הַנַּ֙עַר֙ ל֔וֹ כְּאַחַ֖ד מִבָּנָֽיו׃

passages.text: Micah ordained the Levite, and the young man became his priest and lived in his house.
passages.sermon:
Micah lived in the hill country of Ephraim.
Micah met a young Levite from Bethlehem in Judah.
Micah wanted the Levite to stay with him.
Micah ordained the Levite.
The Levite became Micah’s priest.
The young Levite lived in Micah’s house.
passages.original: וַיְמַלֵּ֤א מִיכָה֙ אֶת־ יַ֣ד הַלֵּוִ֔י וַיְהִי־ ל֥וֹ הַנַּ֖עַר לְכֹהֵ֑ן וַיְהִ֖י בְּבֵ֥ית מִיכָֽה׃

passages.text: Then Micah said, “Now I know that the LORD will be good to me, because a Levite has become my priest.”
passages.sermon:
Micah spoke.
Micah said he now knows something.
Micah said, “Now I know the LORD will be good to me.”
Micah believed this because a Levite became his priest.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מִיכָ֔ה עַתָּ֣ה יָדַ֔עְתִּי כִּֽי־ יֵיטִ֥יב יְהוָ֖ה לִ֑י כִּ֧י הָיָה־ לִ֛י הַלֵּוִ֖י לְכֹהֵֽן׃
